newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa JSE says trade running normally.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa JSE says trade running normally.

text.p: Trade on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's electronic trading system was running normally on Monday, exchange president Roy Andersen said.
Dealers earlier reported that they were having problems logging into their terminals and that their screens were freezing, which was hampering trade.
Andersen told Reuters the system had merely been slowed for a few minutes at the start as the exchange sent out its regular Monday morning messages to members.
"It certainly was not down and it is trading very successfully," Andersen said.
